name: SikaRoof® VersiWall GP Mesh Bracket

breadcrumb.name: Green Roofs and Green Walls Systems

tagline: MESH BRACKET FOR WALL MOUNTED LANDSCAPE GREENING
summary: SikaRoof® VersiWall GP Mesh Bracket is a bracket to mount steel wire meshes onto walls to create green wall facades. Brackets are manufactured from stainless steel (SUS 304), and it has two anti-lift arms to prevent removal of the wire mesh. SikaRoof® VersiWall GP Mesh Bracket is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 2060, SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 2020, SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 250 and SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 150 with a steel wire mesh to create a green wall system.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Products must be stored in their original packing, in their original box, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements.
